title: refactor: fix gocritic findings and delete comments that restate the code
message:
refactor: fix gocritic findings and delete comments that restate the code

Clears the 171 gocritic findings that enabling the linter surfaced, and the
45 comments the overlap gate rejects, so both gates pass on a clean tree.

Real defects fixed, as opposed to style:

- MCP tools could execute the wrong command. iterCommands yielded a path
  slice that registerTools captures in a long-lived handler closure, while
  sibling recursion appended into the same backing array. Past depth two the
  slice has spare capacity, so a sibling overwrote a registered tool's path.
- attestation/verify leaked a file descriptor on both error paths, because
  the close was deferred after them, and dereferenced a nil file when
  CreateTemp failed.
- job/artifact held every extracted file's handles open until the whole
  archive finished; the entry write is now its own function.
- artifactregistry/login could panic on a credentials line that matched with
  fewer submatches than it indexed.
- gen-docs, git.RunClone, alias/expand and two config paths appended to a
  slice they did not own.

Behaviour is unchanged otherwise. Verified by reverting every test file and
running the suite against the production changes alone: 5080 tests pass
either way, so no test was adjusted to accommodate a change.

title: ci: run the comment lint scripts in CI
message:
ci: run the comment lint scripts in CI

Lefthook already runs both, but it can be skipped with LEFTHOOK=0, so CI is
the enforcement point. The overlap check gates at full token coverage; the
ratio report is advisory and cannot fail the job.

title: chore(lint): enable gocritic diagnostic and style checks
message:
chore(lint): enable gocritic diagnostic and style checks

Adds 171 findings on the current tree, cleaned up in the following commit.
Four style checks stay off because they conflict with decisions already
encoded here: two contradict nonamedreturns and the disabled govet shadow
check, one duplicates nolintlint, and one is cosmetic parameter grouping.

title: chore(lint): add comment volume and overlap scripts
message:
chore(lint): add comment volume and overlap scripts

Two dependency-free Go tools for keeping comment noise down, wired into
lefthook.

comment-overlap flags comments whose words are already carried by the
adjacent code, a mechanical proxy for "document only what is non-obvious
from the code". Doc comments are excluded by position through go/ast Doc
fields, so idiomatic godoc is never flagged for repeating its own symbol
name. Gated in pre-commit at full token coverage, where the comment
demonstrably adds nothing; lower thresholds need human judgement and are
for reporting only.

comment-ratio reports how much of a diff is comment rather than code,
split into doc and inline. It judges no single comment, so unlike a
classifier it cannot be defeated by rewording. Advisory in pre-push,
because the measured repo distribution has no natural cutoff.
